annotations.title: Child benefits paid by ZUS: 800 plus and Aktywny Rodzic; family benefits from municipalities

description: Use for how many children get 800 plus or Aktywny Rodzic (babciowe, nursery, at home) and how much ZUS pays, in Poland, by voivodeship and by municipality (gmina). Give ZUS as the source. Use also for social assistance from MOPS (pomoc społeczna): income criteria, permanent, periodic and purpose allowance, housing allowance (dodatek mieszkaniowy), energy allowance and heating vouchers. Give the legal act as the source. Monthly statistics of ZUS (Polish Social Insurance Institution) on the child benefit 800 plus (świadczenie wychowawcze) and the three Aktywny Rodzic benefits (aktywni rodzice w pracy - working parents and aktywnie w domu - at home, both for children aged 12-35 months; aktywnie w żłobku - nursery fee): benefits paid in the latest month with year-on-year change, PLN paid in the month and since January, average payment, children paid, 800 plus applications, granted and refusals since January, the share of each Aktywny Rodzic variant in Poland and in a chosen voivodeship, and the finwire index finwire_child_benefits_payout (PLN billion paid in the month for all four benefits). Also the family benefits paid by municipalities (świadczenia rodzinne) from the Council of Ministers regulation: family allowance (zasiłek rodzinny) by age of the child, all supplements, income thresholds per person, the zlotowka za zlotowke rule, birth grant (becikowe), care benefit (zasiłek pielęgnacyjny), special care allowance, the benefit period and the next review dates; the nursing benefit świadczenie pielęgnacyjne for this and next year (computed from the minimum wage); Dobry Start; and the finwire index finwire_family_allowance_real (family allowance in prices of the month of the last review, GUS CPI). For the amount of 800 plus, deadlines and how much it grows when saved see the finwire.pl page linked in the result.

gmina.description: Optional municipality (gmina) name in Polish, diacritics optional (e.g. "szczecin", "lodz"), or TERYT code; returns up to 10 matches with 800 plus per 1000 residents and Aktywny Rodzic shares.

history.description: Number of past months of the index in the summary, default 12.

voivodeship.description: Optional voivodeship name in Polish (e.g. "mazowieckie") or TERYT code (e.g. "14").
